summary: ORIX Corporation filed a Form 6-K disclosing the status of its ongoing share repurchase under the May 11, 2026 board resolution. Between September 1 and September 30, 2026, ORIX bought 4,021,800 common shares for JPY 24,893,849,100 via market purchases under a discretionary dealing contract. The resolution authorizes up to 100,000,000 shares, roughly 9.1% of outstanding shares excluding treasury, and up to JPY 250 billion through March 31, 2027. Cumulative repurchases total 22,073,800 shares for JPY 138,979,581,400. Watch execution pace versus the remaining authorization and any JPY buyback-yield overhang signals.
